name: figures-human
description: Shared human-figure graphics kit: the walk rig, masc/femme bodies, generic wardrobe articles (coats, boots, caps, hair, tool belts...), faces, common decorations/collision/buildings, and the base materials table. A story lists this module and then only ships the art unique to it, overriding any kit file by dropping its own copy at the same graphics/<kind>/<name>.json path.
